component.name: Tiny Clips (Preview)
component.summary: Capture screenshots and record a shared window or screen

description.p: This development preview is a native GNOME Wayland capture utility. Choose what to share using the desktop permission dialog, crop or annotate a screenshot, and browse captures in the local library.
Video recording and recovery are under test. Microphone audio, system audio and local Agent Control are optional; no account is required.
